verdict.rationale: Extend's Workflows feature (versioned, deployable pipelines) combined with async processing and webhook callbacks lets document-processing tasks run without a user waiting live, which is the core of 'background automation' — evidenced by extend-docs-19, extend-docs-12, extend-docs-13, extend-docs-37, extend-docs-43. However there's no explicit mention of scheduling/triggers (e.g., cron, event subscriptions beyond webhooks) or autonomous multi-step agent loops running unattended over time, so the 'autonomous' framing is only partially substantiated. Missing for 10: explicit scheduling/trigger mechanisms, evidence of long-running unattended agent loops, and independent confirmation that workflows execute fully autonomously without manual intervention.
